_doc: Fixed closed-loop evaluation of the downstream line.  Decision D6 (2026-10-20) fixed the 34 seen target tasks (18 atomic_seen + 16 composite_seen); the user's decision 3 on the step-2 report (2026-10-21) set the episodes: the 9 spatial tasks of spatial_tasks.json x 50 (seeds_spatial) and the other 25 tasks x 20 (seeds) = 950 episodes.  Target kitchens, task-specific horizons of RoboCasa 1.0.1, one policy call per 16-step chunk, counter-region order made process-independent (decision 1 of 2026-10-21; docs/downstream/EVAL_PROTOCOL.md).  Evaluation seeds are separate from training seeds (training uses the experiment's seed 1, 2, 3).
name: seen34_spatial50_v2
